product heatmap-overlay grammar: full-spectrum thermal blobs + numbered 1-10 rank badges + dark annotation pill blended over host UI (the app's true signature surface)

signature_moves: Thermal gradient as a total brand system: same heat ramp at three scales -- product heatmap (full spectrum), icon bolt-cut (green->amber), marketing backdrop (inverted to fresh mint)
Numbered attention-rank badges (1->10) over the heatmap render the F/Z reading order as explicit sequenced UI -- on-brief for an 'attention' tool
One black capsule CTA against a mint field -- disciplined single-dominant-CTA marketing hierarchy
defects: Faked/decorative window chrome -- mac traffic lights on a browser-style frame, no toolbar, no menu bar (mockup asset, non-native tell)
Web selection grammar -- elevated white pill instead of macOS flat inset accent-tinted fill (attributed to borrowed host template)
Evidence gap -- no HeatScope-authored app UI in inputs; the 'app' shown is a third-party AlphaVault demo dashboard obscured ~40% by the overlay

aesthetic.direction: consumer-gradient SaaS marketing composite -- mint mesh-gradient ground + geometric-grotesk wordmark + capsule black CTA, a Playful/toy x Organic-soft blend; brand is committed, host UI is default-template
aesthetic.cluster_hint: gradient-marketing-composite (non-native brand cluster, not a macOS UI cluster)

psychology: Von Restorff / signal-detection -- single black pill CTA against mint ground is the one thing that pops; correct one-primary hierarchy
F/Z reading pattern + serial-position -- product's whole premise; numbered 1->10 badges externalize the attention path the tool measures
Aesthetic-usability effect -- glossy gradient composite raises the trust prior before any feature is read
Jakob's Law -- borrows mac-window mockup + Apple-logo 'Download' conventions to signal 'real native Mac app' (which the evidence does not confirm)
Hick's Law -- host sidebar kept to 5 items; low decision cost (host-template credit, not HeatScope's)
notes: CRITICAL for synthesis: inputs are cover.png (marketing OG composite) + icon.png ONLY -- zero real app screenshots. The window interior is a THIRD-PARTY 'AlphaVault' admin-dashboard demo template used as a canvas for the heatmap product, ~40% obscured by the overlay -- do NOT attribute its tokens to HeatScope, and do NOT feed any of it to macOS canon or open a native cluster (lineage web-electron). Real HeatScope-authored evidence is only the brand layer (mint gradient, bolt/thermal icon, wordmark, black pill CTA) and the product-overlay layer (heatmap + rank badges + annotation pill). All measurements estimated/assumed from a sub-retina downscaled composite. Icon analyzed as brand evidence only (Workflow A task; no icons/ file written). This app cannot level up the corpus's macOS knowledge.
